import ctypes, json, random, sys, time
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from netnomos.finite import compile_job

rng = random.Random(7)

def build_job(job_index):
    """Worst case: 16 cells, universe 65536, 32 predicates, width 4, 10000 train windows, 64 queries."""
    fields = [{'name': f'f{i}', 'type': 'size' if i % 2 else 'count', 'domain': [i, i + 7]} for i in range(4)]
    slots = 4
    predicates = []
    for i in range(32):
        field = fields[i % 4]['name']
        kind = ['cmp','any','all'][i % 3]
        if kind == 'cmp':
            predicates.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[i % slots, field]},'op':'ge','right':{'const':3,'type':fields[i%4]['type']}})
        else:
            predicates.append({'kind':kind,'field':field,'op':'le','value':4})
    train = []
    for _ in range(10000):
        train.append([[rng.choice(f['domain']) for f in fields] for _ in range(slots)])
    approved = []
    for i in range(0, 32, 3):
        approved.append([i])
    queries = []
    for i in range(64):
        queries.append({'target':[i % slots, fields[i % 4]['name']], 'prefix': rng.choice(['','1','0','7']), 'fixed': []})
    return {'fields':fields,'slots':slots,'predicates':predicates,'width':4,'train':train,'approved':approved,'queries':queries}

jobs = [build_job(i) for i in range(6)]
t0 = time.time()
out = {'results':[compile_job(j) for j in jobs]}
print('elapsed', round(time.time()-t0,2), 's')
for r in out['results']:
    print('rules', len(r['rules']), 'active', len(r['active']), 'answers', len(r['answers']))
PYEOF
cd /workspace && time python3 tmp/stress.py
